FACT_ID: sec10-R01 | anchor: A01
Gated crossings hold drivers until bells stop and gates fully rise, while gateless ones demand slowed stop-ready approaches with confirmed-clear tracks, signaled versus self-judged entries. [A01]
Why it matters: group crossings; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec10-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=60]

FACT_ID: sec10-R02 | anchor: A02
Stalled cars empty every occupant at once, clear the rails without waiting to sight a train, and phone the posted emergency number before anything else. [A02]
Why it matters: group stalls; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec10-F05 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=61]

FACT_ID: sec10-R03 | anchor: A07
Escapees run toward the oncoming train at forty-five degrees off the rails rather than down-track with it, dodging the debris cone of the impact. [A07]
Why it matters: group stalls; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec10-F21 [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=66]

FACT_ID: sec10-R04 | anchor: A05
Rear-wheel slides steer into the travel direction with anti-lock steadiness or quickening pumps, while front-wheel slides lift off gas shift neutral and withhold steering until drag restores grip. [A05]
Why it matters: group skids; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec10-F15 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=64]

FACT_ID: sec10-R05 | anchor: A03
Full ramps accelerate to traffic speed for rolling merges, but stub lanes stop dead to await wide gaps before sprinting aboard, opposite entries for opposite geometry. [A03]
Why it matters: group expressways; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec10-F07 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=62]

FACT_ID: sec10-R06 | anchor: A04
High beams serve empty dark roads yet low beams rule within five hundred feet meeting, two hundred following, and all falling weather where highs blind back. [A04]
Why it matters: group beams; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec10-F11, sec10-F13 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=63]

FACT_ID: sec10-R07 | anchor: A06
Dead brakes invite pumping then gradual emergency and downshift, while dead steering invites coasting gas-off flashers-on and brake-off, pressure versus patience. [A06]
Why it matters: group failures; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec10-F18, sec10-F19 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=65]
